examples.en: Whenever I watch that show, I can't help laughing.
My grandmother is always quick to laugh.
That comedian brings laughter to people.

examples.ko: 너무 웃겨서 웃음을 참을 수 없었어요.
examples.en: It was so funny that I couldn't hold back my laughter.

examples.ko: 옆방에서 웃음소리가 크게 들려요. 무슨 일이에요?
examples.en: I can hear loud laughter from the next room. What's going on?

explain: 웃다에 “-음”을 붙여서 만든 명사예요. 울다 → 울음, 얼다 → 얼음도 같은 방식이에요.

phrases.en: to be filled with laughter (lit. laughter blossoms)

explain_en: It is a noun made by adding -음 to 웃다. 울다 → 울음 and 얼다 → 얼음 follow the same pattern.

examples.en: My younger sibling didn't cry. He held back his tears.
The baby's crying woke me up at dawn.
The child suddenly burst into tears.
I started crying while watching a sad movie.

examples.ko: 아침에 새 울음소리를 들으면 기분이 좋아요.
examples.en: Hearing birds sing in the morning makes me feel good.

explain: 소리 내서 우는 것은 “울음”, 눈에서 나오는 물은 “눈물”이에요. 둘은 달라요.
